description: HTML file containing a calendar widget implementation with embedded JavaScript functions for date selection and visibility testing of form elements.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: A JavaScript class for rendering and managing a calendar widget.

methods.name: selected
methods.description: Handles date selection from the calendar, updates input field, and closes calendar if applicable.

methods.name: closeHandler
methods.description: Hides the calendar without destroying it.

methods.name: showCalendar
methods.description: Displays the calendar widget under a specified element with a given date format.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a date should be disabled based on a range from the current date.
